Rashi on Eruvin 71a:10:1.hebrew: כלך אצל יפות - גבי תורם את של חבירו שלא מדעת, תניא (ב"מ דף כב.): בא בעל הבית ומצאו שהוא תורם, ואמר לו: ״כלך אצל יפות״ — אם יש לו יפות מהן, תרומתו תרומה, דגלי אדעתיה דניחא ליה, ואמרינן: כמאן דשוויה שליח מעיקרא דמי. ה"נ, כיון דבטיל השתא, גלי דעתיה דמעיקרא בשריותא ניחא ליה, אלא ששכח ולא עירב, ולא הוה ליה אקנויי רשותא בשבת:
Rashi on Eruvin 71a:10:1.english: Turn toward the high-quality ones - In the case of one who separates teruma from his fellow’s [produce] without [his fellow’s] knowledge, it is taught [in a baraita] (Bava Metzia 22a): The homeowner came and found him separating teruma, and said to him, “Turn toward the high-quality ones” — if he has [produce that is] of higher quality than them, his teruma is [valid] teruma, for he has revealed his intention that it is pleasing to him, and we say [that] it is considered as if he made him an agent from the outset. Here too, since he renounces [his rights] now, he reveals his intention that from the outset he desired permissibility [to carry in the courtyard], but he forgot and did not join in the eiruv; and [thus] it is not [considered] transferring [ownership of] domain on Shabbat.

Rashi on Eruvin 71a:12:1.english: And acquiring a domain on Shabbat is prohibited - For it is similar to buying and selling.

Rashi on Eruvin 71a:13:1.hebrew: שהיה שותף עם שכניו - שבמבוי, לשם שותפות בעלמא, ולא לשם שיתוף:
Rashi on Eruvin 71a:13:1.english: Who was in partnership with his neighbors - [Those] in the alleyway; for the sake of an ordinary partnership, and not for the sake of a shittuf.

Rashi on Eruvin 71a:13:2.hebrew: לזה ביין ולזה ביין כו' - בגמרא מוקי לה בכלי א':
Rashi on Eruvin 71a:13:2.english: With this [one] in wine and with that [one] in wine, etc. - In the Gemara, [the Gemara] establishes it [as referring to wine] in one vessel.

Rashi on Eruvin 71a:14:1.hebrew: לזה ביין ולזה בשמן - אין זה שיתוף א', ואין יכול לסמוך עליו, שהרי חלוק בשני כלים:
Rashi on Eruvin 71a:14:1.english: With this one in wine and with that one in oil - This is not a single shituf, and one cannot rely upon it, as it is divided into two vessels.

Rashi on Eruvin 71a:15:1.hebrew: אמר רב ובכלי אחד - שכולן היה שותפותן בכלי אחד, אבל בשני כלים — לא. ואע"ג דאמרי ב"ה בפרק מי שהוציאוהו (לעיל עירובין דף מט.), "עירוב הנתון בשני כלים כשר" — התם הוא דמעיקרא לשם עירוב גבו, ומליוה למנא ואייתר; אבל הכא דלאו לשם שיתוף הוה, בכלי א' — אין, בב' כלים — לא:
Rashi on Eruvin 71a:15:1.english: Rav said: And in one vessel - That all of them had their partnership in one vessel, but in two vessels, no. And even though Beit Hillel said in the chapter entitled "Mi SheHotzi'uhu" (above, Eruvin 49a) that an eiruv placed in two vessels is valid, that is only there, where from the beginning they collected food for the sake of an eiruv, and they filled the vessel and there was a remainder; but here, where it was not collected for the sake of a shituf, in one vessel, yes, but in two vessels, no.

Rashi on Eruvin 71a:16:1.hebrew: יין ויין ראוי לערב - הלכך, אע"פ דלא ערביה, סמכינן עליה:
Rashi on Eruvin 71a:16:1.english: Wine and wine is suitable for mixing - Therefore, even though he did not mix it [together], we rely upon it.

Rashi on Eruvin 71a:17:1.hebrew: ואפי' לזה ביין ולזה בשמן - בתמיה: הא לא חזי לעירוב:
Rashi on Eruvin 71a:17:1.english: And even with this one in wine and with that one in oil - [This is asked] in astonishment: Behold, it is not fit for an eiruv!

Rashi on Eruvin 71a:17:2.hebrew: שבין ב' מבואות - ולא בשיתוף דמבוי אחד קאמר, אלא עם זה נשתתפה ביין ועם זה בשמן, ושני עירובין הן:
Rashi on Eruvin 71a:17:2.english: That is between two alleyways - And [Rabbi Shimon] was not speaking of the shittuf of a single alleyway; rather, with this [alleyway the courtyard] partnered in wine, and with that [alleyway] in oil, and they are two [separate] eiruvs.

Rashi on Eruvin 71a:17:3.hebrew: ור"ש לטעמיה - דאמר: חצר אחת יכולה לערב ב' עירובין עם ב' מבואות, ואע"פ שלא שיתפו ב' המבואות יחד. ה"נ, אע"פ שאין השיתוף מחובר יחד ולא הותרו מבואות זה עם זה — היא מותרת עם שניהם, ולא גזרינן דילמא אתי לאפוקי כלים ששבתו במבוי זה למבוי זה דרך חצר זו:
Rashi on Eruvin 71a:17:3.english: And Rabbi Shimon [follows] his reasoning - For he said [that] a single courtyard can make two eiruvs with two alleyways, even though the two alleyways did not establish a shituf together. So too here, even though the shituf is not combined together and the alleyways are not permitted to one another, it [the courtyard] is permitted with both of them; and we do not decree lest one come to carry out vessels that rested [on Shabbat] in this alleyway into that alleyway by way of this courtyard.

Rashi on Eruvin 71a:18:1.hebrew: למה הדבר דומה - בפ' מי שהוציאוהו. ולרבנן דמתני', אם נשתתפה ביין ובכלי א', הוו להו ב' המבואות כמי שנשתתפו יחד, ושפיר דמי. אבל לזה ביין ולזה בשמן — דתרי עירובי נינהו — כיון דב' המבואות אסורין זה עם זה, היא נמי אסורה עמהן, ושניהן אסורין עמה, כדקתני בפרק מי שהוציאוהו:
Rashi on Eruvin 71a:18:1.english: To what is this matter comparable? - [This mishna is taught] in the chapter [entitled] Mi Shehotziuho. And according to the Rabbis of our mishna, if [the courtyard] partnered [with both alleyways] in wine and in one vessel, the two alleyways are considered as though they partnered together, and it is well. But [if it partnered] with this one in wine and with that one in oil — as they are two [separate] eiruvs — since the two alleyways are prohibited with each other, it is also prohibited [to carry] with them, and both of them are prohibited [to carry] with it, as it teaches in the chapter [entitled] Mi Shehotziuho.

Rashi on Eruvin 71a:1:1.hebrew: אע"פ שהחזיק כו' - לקמן פריך: מאי אע"פ שהחזיק כו':
Rashi on Eruvin 71a:1:1.english: Even though [a different Jew] took possession, etc. - Later on, [the Gemara] asks: What is [the meaning of] “Even though [a different Jew] took possession,” etc.?

Rashi on Eruvin 71a:1:2.english: Renders [carrying] prohibited - The one who took possession [renders it prohibited] for the resident.

Rashi on Eruvin 71a:1:3.english: After nightfall - For the eiruv had already taken effect.

Rashi on Eruvin 71a:1:4.hebrew: אע"פ - פריך לקמן: כי לא החזיק, הוה ליה זה דר יחיד, וליכא דאסר עליה. והאי דאסר — משום דהחזיק הוא, והכי איבעי ליה למיתני: אם החזיק ישראל אחר בנכסיו — אוסר:
Rashi on Eruvin 71a:1:4.english: Even though - [The Gemara] challenges below: If [another Jew] did not take possession, this [remaining Jew] would be a sole resident, and there is no one who prohibits [carrying] upon him; and this [fact] that he prohibits is because he took possession. And so it should have taught: If another Jew took possession of his property, he prohibits.

Rashi on Eruvin 71a:1:5.hebrew: אע"פ שלא החזיק - מבעוד יום מיד, והמתין עד שחשיכה, ואיכא היתר למקצת שבת — אוסר, כדמפרש לקמן: הואיל והיה לו כח להחזיק בה מבעוד יום אם ירצה, נמצאת רשות זו תלויה ועומדת, ולא הוה הותר למקצת שבת:
Rashi on Eruvin 71a:1:5.english: Even though he did not take possession - [Meaning,] immediately while it was still day, and he waited until nightfall, and [thus] there is permission for part of Shabbat — [nevertheless,] he renders [carrying] prohibited, as [the Gemara] explains below: Since he had the power to take possession of it while it was still day if he wished, this domain is found to be in suspense, and it was not permitted for part of Shabbat.

Rashi on Eruvin 71a:20:1.hebrew: שכנים בהדי הדדי - אם רוצין בני מבוי זה להשתמש בזה, צריכין לערב, ולתת כולן פת בחצר זו. ואית דמפרשי: מתני' מילי מילי קתני, ור"ש לאו אמילתייהו קאי, דאילו רבנן — בחצר שבין ב' מבואות, אפי' לזה ביין ולזה ביין, לא. זו פירשתי, וראשון נראה בעיני:
Rashi on Eruvin 71a:20:1.english: The neighbors with each other - If the residents of this alleyway wish to make use of that [one], they must establish an eiruv and all of them [must] place bread in this courtyard. And there are those who explain: The Mishnah teaches distinct cases, and Rabbi Shimon is not addressing their [the Rabbis'] words, for according to the Rabbis, in [the case of] a courtyard between two alleyways, even [if he partnered] with this one in wine and with that one in wine, [it is] not [permitted]. This [latter explanation] I explained, but the first [explanation] appears [correct] in my eyes.

Rashi on Eruvin 71a:4:1.hebrew: ה"ק - חסורי מיחסר', והאי אע"פ — אשהחזיק קאי. ושלא החזיק דקתני — ה"ק: ולא היה לו להחזיק מבעוד יום, שלא היתה רשות זו תלויה בין השמשות אלא מוחזקת לגר; אם היה זה בא להחזיק — לא היה יכול. היתר היה בה למקצת שבת, ואינו אוסר:
Rashi on Eruvin 71a:4:1.english: This is what [the baraita] is saying - [The baraita] is missing [words], and this [phrase] “even though” refers to [the case where] he took possession. And [as for] that which it teaches, “and [even though] he did not take possession” — this is what it is saying: and he did not have [the ability] to take possession while it was still day, for this domain was not in suspense at twilight, but rather held by the convert; if this [person] had come to take possession, he would not have been able to. [Therefore,] there was permission regarding it for part of Shabbat, and he does not render [carrying] prohibited.

Rashi on Eruvin 71a:6:1.hebrew: אימא אף ע"פ שהחזיק - אינו אוסר, הואיל והותר למקצת שבת:
Rashi on Eruvin 71a:6:1.english: Say: Even though he took possession - He does not render [carrying] prohibited, since it was permitted for part of Shabbat.

Rashi on Eruvin 71a:6:2.hebrew: ה"ק - חסורי מיחסר', והאי אע"פ — אשהחזיק קאי. ושלא החזיק דקתני, ה"ק: ולא היה לו להחזיק מבעוד יום, שלא היתה רשות זו תלויה בין השמשות, אלא מוחזקת לגר; אם היה זה בא להחזיק — לא היה יכול. היתר היה בה למקצת שבת, ואינו אוסר:
Rashi on Eruvin 71a:6:2.english: This is what it is saying - [The baraita] is missing [words], and this [phrase] “even though” refers to “he took possession.” And [as for that] which it teaches, “and he did not take possession,” this is what it is saying: And he was not able to take possession while it was still day, for this domain was not suspended at twilight, but rather retained by the convert; if this [person] had come to take possession, he would not have been able to. [Therefore,] there was permissibility in it for part of Shabbat, and he does not render [carrying] prohibited.

Rashi on Eruvin 71a:9:1.hebrew: ר' יוחנן אמר - הני תרתי מתניתא בתרייתא דאמרי יורש אוסר, ב"ש היא:
Rashi on Eruvin 71a:9:1.english: Rabbi Yoḥanan said - These two latter baraitot that say [that] an heir renders [carrying] prohibited — it is [the view of] Beit Shammai.

Tosafot on Eruvin 71a:10:1.hebrew: כלך אצל יפות - פי' רש"י: דכשיש לו יפות מהן, גלי דעתיה דניחא ליה, והוי כמאן דשויה שליח מעיקרא דמי. ואין להקשות לפירושו מהא דמוקי לה בריש אלו מציאות (ב"מ דף כב.) כגון דשויה שליח — דנהי דשויה שליח לתרום, לא שויה שליח לתרום מן היפות; ועל זה מפרש בקונטרס: כמאן דשויה שליח לתרום מן היפות דמי, כיון דנמצא יפות מהן:
Tosafot on Eruvin 71a:10:1.english: "Turn toward the high-quality ones" - Rashi explained that when he has [produce that is] of higher quality than them, he reveals his intention that he is pleased, and it is considered as if he had made him an agent from the outset. And one should not raise an objection against his explanation from that which [the Gemara] establishes it at the beginning of Elu Metzi'ot (Bava Metzia 22a) [as a case] where he made him an agent — for although he made him an agent to separate [terumah], he did not make him an agent to separate from the high-quality produce; and regarding this the Kuntres explains [that] it is considered as if he made him an agent to separate from the high-quality produce, since [produce] of higher quality than them was found.

Tosafot on Eruvin 71a:12:1.hebrew: ומקני רשותא בשבת אסור - תימה, דבגיטין בריש הזורק (גיטין דף עז:) גבי ההוא שכיב מרע, אמר דליקני לה דוכתא דמנח ביה גיטא ותיזל איהי ותיחד ותפתח, ושבת היתה, כדאיתא התם! וי"ל: דשכיב מרע התירו, שלא תטרף דעתו עליו. ואין לומר: דדוקא קנין שאינו צריך הוא דשרי, כי ההיא [דפרק מי שמת] (ב"ב קנו:) דבלא קנין קני, כדאמר התם דאין הלכה כר' אלעזר — דהא משמע [התם] דאי הוה הלכה כר' אלעזר, כ"ש דהוה ניחא טפי שהיו צריכין להתיר, והכי נמי איכא למיחש למיטרף דעת אם לא היה יכול לגרשה כרצונו. תדע, דאף בלא קנין איכא איסורא לגרש בשבת, כדתניא בתוספתא: "דאין מקדשין ואין מגרשין בשבת". אלא ודאי בשכיב מרע דוקא התירו, שלא תטרוף דעתו — שירא שימות בשבת ואינו רוצה להמתין עד החול; וה"ה דהתירו נמי קנין. וכן פסק רבינו שמואל, דאפי' מתנת שכיב מרע במקצת דבעיא קנין, קונין ממנו בשבת:
Tosafot on Eruvin 71a:12:1.english: "And acquisition of a domain on Shabbat is prohibited" - [This is] difficult, as in Gittin at the beginning of [the chapter entitled] HaZorek (Gittin 77b), regarding that dying man [shekhiv mera], [Rava] said that he should transfer ownership to her of the place where the bill of divorce [get] is resting, and let her go and lock and open [it], and it was Shabbat, as is stated there! And it can be said: In the case of a dying man they permitted [it], so that his mind should not become unhinged upon him. And one cannot say that specifically an unnecessary act of acquisition is permitted, like that [case] in the chapter [entitled] Mi SheMeit (Bava Batra 156b), where without an acquisition it is acquired, as [the Gemara] says there that the halakhah is not in accordance with Rabbi Elazar — for indeed [the Gemara there] implies that if the halakhah had been in accordance with Rabbi Elazar, all the more so would it be all the better that they would have needed to permit it; and here too there is reason to be concerned about his mind becoming unhinged if he were not able to divorce her as he wished. Know [that this is so], for even without an acquisition there is a prohibition against divorcing on Shabbat, as it is taught in the Tosefta: "One may neither betroth nor divorce on Shabbat." Rather, certainly, specifically in the case of a dying man they permitted it, so that his mind should not become unhinged — since he fears that he will die on Shabbat and does not want to wait until the weekday; and the same applies [such that] they also permitted acquisition. And so ruled Rabbeinu Shmuel, that even for a gift of a dying man of part [of his estate], which requires an acquisition, one may acquire from him on Shabbat.

Tosafot on Eruvin 71a:15:1.hebrew: אי אמרת בשלמא רישא בכלי אחד כו' - והוא הדין יין ויין בב' כלים, אבל אורחא דמלתא נקט. ועוד, דלא הוצרך התנא לפרש, דסתם יין ושמן בב' כלים. אע"ג דשרו ב"ה בפרק מי שהוציאוהו (לעיל עירובין דף מט.) עירוב הנתון בשני כלים כי מלייה למנא ואייתר — ה"מ כי גבו לשם עירוב, כדפי' בקונטרס; אבל הכא דלאו לשם שתוף — בכלי א' אין, בשני כלים לא:
Tosafot on Eruvin 71a:15:1.english: Granted, if you say that the first clause [deals] with one vessel, etc. - And the same law applies to wine and wine in two vessels [that they must establish an eiruv], but [the Tanna] stated the common case. And furthermore, the Tanna did not need to specify [two vessels], since wine and oil are typically in two vessels. Even though Beit Hillel permit in the chapter [entitled] Mi SheHotzi’uhu (above, Eruvin 49a) an eiruv placed in two vessels where one filled the [first] vessel and there was a remainder — this applies only when they collected [it] for the purpose of an eiruv, as explained in the Kuntres; but here, where it was not [initially collected] for the purpose of a shituf, in one vessel — yes, in two vessels — no.

Tosafot on Eruvin 71a:16:1.hebrew: יין ושמן אין ראוי לערב - אף ע"ג דכל האוכלין מצטרפין למזון ב' סעודות לעירוב, וה"ה משקין — היינו כשנשתתפו לשם עירוב:
Tosafot on Eruvin 71a:16:1.english: Wine and oil are not suitable for mixing - Even though all foods combine to [constitute] food for two meals for an eiruv, and the same applies to beverages — that is [only] when they joined together for the sake of an eiruv.

Tosafot on Eruvin 71a:17:1.hebrew: בחצר שבין ב' מבואות כו' - לא בעי לאוקומי בג' חצירות ממש כאידך משנה, דעירובי חצירות בעי פת, בין לר"מ בין לרבנן דלקמן בסמוך; ואין רוצה להעמיד מתני' כמ"ד ביין, ופליג אר"מ ורבנן:
Tosafot on Eruvin 71a:17:1.english: "With a courtyard between two alleyways, etc." - [Rabba] did not want to interpret [our Mishnah as dealing] literally with three courtyards, like the other Mishnah, because an eiruv of courtyards requires bread according to both Rabbi Meir and the Rabbis [in the baraita cited] shortly below; and he did not want to establish our Mishnah in accordance with the one who says [that it may be made] with wine, who disagrees with Rabbi Meir and the Rabbis.

Tosafot on Eruvin 71a:17:2.hebrew: ור' שמעון לטעמיה - דלא גזר. לרב ששת, דמוקי לה לעיל בפרק מי שהוציאוהו (עירובין דף מח.) שנתנו שתים עירובן באמצעית ובב' בתים — הכא, אפי' בבית א' ובשני כלים, כב' בתים דמו, כיון דלא עביד לשם שיתוף; דממה נפשך תרוייהו הכא בחצר קיימי, דשיתופי מבואות בחצר שבמבוי:
Tosafot on Eruvin 71a:17:2.english: "And Rabbi Shimon follows his reasoning" - In that he does not decree [a prohibition]. And according to Rav Sheshet, who establishes [the mishna] above in the chapter [entitled] Mi SheHotzi'uhu (Eruvin 48a) [as referring to a case] where the two [outer courtyards] placed their eiruv in the middle [courtyard] and in two [separate] houses — here, even in one house and in two vessels, they are considered like two houses, since it was not done for the purpose of a shituf; for in any event, both of them stand here in the courtyard, as the shituf-partnerships of alleyways [are placed] in a courtyard that is in an alleyway.
